preconditions.description: The number of strings n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 and s.islower() and s.isalpha() for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string consists of 1 to 100 lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'NO' or (output_lines[0] == 'YES' and len(output_lines) == n + 1 and all(output_lines[i+1] in strings for i in range(n)) and all(output_lines[i+1] in output_lines[j+1] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)))
postconditions.description: If impossible, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by n strings that are a permutation of the input, such that every string is a substring of all subsequent strings in the list.
